name: Aloes
overview: Scripture reveals that aloes were valued for their fragrant and preservative qualities, often used as perfume and in embalming the dead. The Song of Solomon and Proverbs describe aloes as part of rich, aromatic blends that bring joy and refreshment, while John records Nicodemus bringing a large quantity of myrrh and aloes to anoint Jesus' body, underscoring their role in sacred burial practices. Additionally, Numbers 24:6 references lign-aloes as a symbol of strength and divine planting, highlighting their significance beyond mere fragrance.
